points.name: evolved-1024
points.note: DSL program, programs/evolved-1024.dsl
points.detail:
def wins() -> Bool:
    """Found by search run r1 (2026-11-25, Haiku 5.5, 1,076 proposals): the best program within 1,024 operations (also best at 4,096). Verified against Syzygy."""
    f = file(P)
    r = rank(P)
    n = min(5, 7 - r)
    q = sq(f, 7)
    blocked = k in path(strong, P)
    adj = P in king_f(K)
    front = sq(f, r + 2)
    runs = n + 1 - tempo < dist(k, q) and not blocked
    support = f > 0 and tempo == 0 and adj and dist(k, q) == n + 1 and not blocked
    ks = minus(king_f(front), king_f(P))
    free = compl(king_f(k))
    corner = min(min(dist(k, sq(0, 7)), dist(k, sq(1, 7))), min(dist(k, sq(0, 6)), dist(k, sq(2, 7))))
    reach = any(steps(K, s, free) + tempo < dist(k, s) + tempo for s in ks) if f > 0 else dist(K, sq(1, 6)) < corner + tempo
    blockade = blocked and r < 6 and not adj and not (K in king_f(front)) and not (dist(K, front) < dist(k, front) + tempo)
    cap = tempo < 1 and k in king_f(P) and not adj
    opp = f > 0 and dist(K, k) == 2 and (file(K) == file(k) or rank(K) == rank(k)) and tempo == 0 and dist(K, P) < dist(k, P)
    near = r >= 5 and f > 0 and dist(K, q) + tempo <= dist(k, q)
    return (runs or support or (reach and not dist(k, P) + tempo < dist(K, P)) or opp or near) and not blockade and not cap

points.note: DSL program, programs/evolved-256.dsl
points.detail:
def wins() -> Bool:
    """Found by search run r1 (2026-11-25, Haiku 5.5, 1,076 proposals): the best program within 256 operations. Verified against Syzygy."""
    f = file(P)
    r = rank(P)
    q = sq(f, 7)
    n = min(5, 7 - r)
    dq = dist(k, q)
    dkp = dist(k, P)
    dKP = dist(K, P)
    dKq = dist(K, q)
    blocked = k in path(strong, P)
    runs = n + 1 - tempo < dq and not blocked
    support = f > 0 and tempo == 0 and dKP <= 1 and dq == n + 1 and not blocked
    corner = f == 0 and dq <= n + 1 - tempo and dKq + tempo > dq
    front = sq(f, r + 2)
    ahead = front in king_f(K) or dist(K, front) < dist(k, front) + tempo
    loose = dkp + tempo < dKP
    side = abs(file(K) - f) <= 1 and rank(K) > r
    blockade = blocked and r < 6 and dKP > 1 and not side and not ahead
    cap = tempo < 1 and dkp == 1 and dKP > 1
    aligned = file(K) == file(k) or rank(K) == rank(k)
    opp = dist(K, k) == 2 and aligned and tempo == 0 and f > 0 and dKP <= dkp and rank(K) > r
    near = r >= 5 and f > 0 and dKq + tempo <= dq and not cap
    return (runs or support or (ahead and not loose) or (opp and not blockade) or near) and not blockade and not cap and not corner

points.name: human
points.note: DSL program, programs/human.dsl
points.detail:
def wins() -> Bool:
    """Textbook KPK by hand: rule of the square, key squares two ranks ahead (also one ahead from
    rank 5), the rook-pawn corner, and a loose pawn the weak king reaches first."""
    f = file(P)
    r = rank(P)
    q = sq(f, 7)
    n = min(5, 7 - r)
    runs = n + 1 - tempo < dist(k, q) and K not in path(strong, P)
    ks = inter(union(rank_f(r + 2), rank_f(r + 1 if r > 3 else 8)), union(file_f(f), union(file_f(f - 1), file_f(f + 1))))
    reach = any(dist(K, s) < dist(k, s) + tempo for s in ks) if f > 0 else dist(K, sq(1, 6)) < min(dist(k, sq(2, 7)), dist(k, sq(1, 7)), dist(k, sq(2, 6)), dist(k, sq(0, 7))) + tempo
    loose = dist(k, P) + tempo < dist(K, P)
    return runs or (reach and not loose)

# Promoted 2026-11-26 from state/run-r1/trimmed-966-4430B-1019ops.dsl: 4,430.0 B (138.3 B program, 4,291.8 B exceptions), 5,398 errors, at most 1,019 operations, tier 1,024.
# Run r1 program 966 (4,476 B, 4 operations over its island's limit), shortened by a greedy mechanical trimmer without a model (first try of trimming, docs/STATUS.md); verified against Syzygy.
def wins() -> Bool:
    x0 = file(P)
    x1 = rank(P)
    x2 = sq(x0, 7)
    x3 = min(5, (7 - x1))
    x4 = (k in path(strong, P))
    x5 = (P in king_f(K))
    x6 = sq(x0, (x1 + 2))
    x7 = ((((x3 + 1) - tempo) < dist(k, x2)) and (not x4))
    x8 = ((0 < x0) and (x5 and ((dist(k, x2) == (x3 + 1)) and (not x4))))
    x9 = minus(king_f(x6), king_f(P))
    x10 = compl(king_f(k))
    x12 = (any(((steps(K, x11, x10) + tempo) < (dist(k, x11) + tempo)) for x11 in x9) if (0 < x0) else (dist(K, sq(1, 6)) < (min(min(dist(k, sq(2, 7)), dist(k, sq(1, 7))), dist(k, sq(0, 7))) + tempo)))
    x13 = steps(K, x6, x10)
    x14 = (x4 and ((not x5) and (not (x13 < (dist(k, x6) + tempo)))))
    x15 = ((tempo < 1) and ((k in king_f(P)) and (not x5)))
    x16 = (file(K) == file(k))
    x17 = ((0 < x0) and ((dist(K, k) == 2) and (x16 and ((tempo == 0) and (dist(K, P) < dist(k, P))))))
    x18 = ((5 <= x1) and ((0 < x0) and ((not x4) and (dist(K, x2) <= dist(k, x2)))))
    return ((x7 or (x8 or ((x12 and (not ((dist(k, P) + tempo) < dist(K, P)))) or ((x17 and (not x14)) or x18)))) and ((not x14) and (not x15)))

points.name: r1-unit-831
points.note: DSL program, programs/r1-unit-831.dsl
points.detail:
# Promoted 2026-11-26 from state/run-r1/unit-831-4426B-1259ops.dsl: 4,426.4 B (156.1 B program, 4,270.4 B exceptions), 5,363 errors, at most 1,259 operations, tier 4,096.
# Run r1 proposal 831 (Claude Haiku 5.5), rejected by its island for using more than 1,024 operations; it fits the 4,096 tier.
def wins() -> Bool:
    f = file(P)
    r = rank(P)
    q = sq(f, 7)
    n = min(5, 7 - r)
    blocked = k in path(strong, P)
    adj = P in king_f(K)
    front = sq(f, r + 2)
    runs = n + 1 - tempo < dist(k, q) and not blocked
    support = f > 0 and tempo == 0 and adj and dist(k, q) == n + 1 and not blocked
    ks = minus(king_f(front), king_f(P))
    free = compl(guard(weak))
    bk = compl(king_f(K))
    reach = any(steps(K, s, free) + tempo < steps(k, s, union(bk, one(s))) + tempo for s in ks) if f > 0 else dist(K, sq(1, 6)) < min(dist(k, sq(2, 7)), dist(k, sq(1, 7)), dist(k, sq(2, 6)), dist(k, sq(0, 7))) + tempo
    blockade = blocked and r < 6 and not adj and not (K in king_f(front)) and not (dist(K, front) < dist(k, front) + tempo)
    cap = tempo < 1 and k in king_f(P) and not adj
    aligned = file(K) == file(k) or rank(K) == rank(k)
    opp = f > 0 and dist(K, k) == 2 and aligned and tempo == 0 and dist(K, P) < dist(k, P)
    near = r >= 5 and f > 0 and dist(K, q) + tempo <= dist(k, q)
    return (runs or support or (reach and not dist(k, P) + tempo < dist(K, P)) or (opp and not blockade) or near) and not blockade and not cap
